|lore='Traveling through hyperspace ain't like dustin' crops, boy!' Gravitational phenomena cast shadows in hyperspace, posing a serious threat to lightspeed navigation.
|game_text=If opponent's starship is about to move through hyperspace, target that starship and its highest-ability pilot. Draw destiny. If destiny &gt; pilot's ability, starship may not move this turn. If destiny = pilot's ability, starship is lost.

|rulings=* Can be played as a response to any hyperspace movement, including (for example) [[Hyper Escape]].<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json card data], entry <code>102_8</code>, <code>rulings</code> field. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026181124id_/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive].</ref>
* Targets both the starship and the highest ability pilot (either a permanent pilot or a character who is piloting).
* If multiple permanent pilots and/or character pilots are tied for highest ability, Dark chooses one to target.
* For [[Han, Chewie, And The Falcon]], targets [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]]'s 3 ability.
